_doc: C5a G-MOCK (glass.py cmp, contracts/lab.md section 3): live selectors for the game-page mockups. The mockup builder (docs/phase2/mockups/game-pages.js) tags the cluster slots, tab capsule, logo box, chip and stats line with data-id. Run with --flags wp.c5a,wp.c1a,wp.p3 (T2 labels the Steam Input capsule) and --mode pad (Play focused, as the mockup). Known, explained differences: the mockup's title is 'Starfall Drift'; the stats map one stat each (stat1, stat2: label and value on one line); 'input' is the labelled capsule, whose width follows its label; the mockup's tab capsule holds 'Your Stuff' and its own font metrics (dw); the arrows are two circles live (P-83), one paired capsule in the mockup, so they are not mapped.
